messages:
clare: dropped a new variant for the trace detail action bar — curious about export prominence vs truncation on narrow screens. figma: https://redwood.test/figma/trace-actions-v2
mira: very useful. my main worry is discoverability during incidents. export is often needed quickly so hiding it in kebab hurts.
jon: +1. support asks for "Download trace" wording instead of "Export" since it reads clearer for non-engineers.
jess: accessibility checklist: 1) icon-only buttons need aria-labels; 2) toolbar should have role=toolbar and aria-label="Trace actions"; 3) keyboard order must match visible order.
kai: engineering note: export is an async job that returns a signed URL via notifications. we can add a persistent download chip in the UI for 24h. also, manifest.json inside zip is doable.
clare: thinking of three primaries: [Copy correlation ID] [Open trace in new tab] [Download trace]. kebab keeps annotate/pin/share. on mobile collapse to icons-only but ensure 44px touch targets.
mira: copy wording nit: use "Copy correlation ID" not "Copy ID" and for frames use "Copy frame location". explicit is better.
jess: for screen readers, announce start/finish of export with an ARIA live region: "Trace download started. A link will appear in notifications." and on ready: "Trace download ready: link in notifications."
jon: filename pattern suggestion: trace-<trace_id>-<env>-<YYYYMMDD_HHMM>.zip so support can quickly identify. include manifest.json describing included fields and filters.
kai: implementation detail: CSV flattening is extra CPU; make it an explicit preset in modal. default quick-download should be JSON zip for speed.
clare: modal vs inline dropdown for export options? i prefer modal for accessibility (focus trap) and to show estimated size/time.
jess: agree modal is better for advanced options; but primary download click should be fast (no modal). advanced options in kebab -> "Download (advanced)" opens modal.
a11y-bot: automated scan: current icon-hover contrast 2.7:1 (fails). recommend increasing hover contrast or adding 3px focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast.
mira: add visible focus ring for keyboard users and ensure tab order aligns. also add tooltip once per session: "Tip: press C to copy correlation ID" but make sure tooltip is also available in keyboard help modal (not only hover).
jon: behavior for copy on truncated ids: UI shows ellipsis but copy action must copy full id. add aria-describedby referencing hidden text "Full id copied" on success.
kai: question about copy-with-context: should default copy be raw id? i'd prefer raw id default; kebab can offer "Copy with link + context".
jess: keyboard shortcuts plan: C=copy, O=open, D=download, K=toggle kebab. ensure these don't conflict with inline code editors. add a small key hint in the action tooltip and update keyboard help overlay.
clare: mobile long-press on copy reveals a mini-menu: "Copy ID" and "Copy with link". long-press should be accessible via a context menu for keyboard users too (right-click / menu key).
a11y-bot: modal check: ensure role=dialog, focus trap active, close button has aria-label, and export options (checkboxes/radios) have accessible labels.
mira: one more UX nudge: show a small inline status under Download when job queued/processing (dot + label) so users know progress without hunting notifications.
jon: small copy: in notifications use "Trace download ready — click to download (expires in 24h)". more actionable.
jess: final a11y ask: include header row descriptions when CSV chosen, e.g., "span_id (hex)" so screen reader users have context in spreadsheets.
clare: action items: 1) design to update mock with Download wording, 44px touch targets, toolbar role, and queued/processing indicators (clare). 2) eng to implement filename pattern, manifest.json, async toast + persistent chip, and copy behaviors (kai, jon). 3) a11y to re-run scan and verify live region flow (jess). will post updated frames by EOD and tag for crit review. :thumbsup:
